explication: Free GST Billing is an offline-first GST invoicing and small-business management app. The main workflow enters through the application shell, creates and previews invoices, then persists business records locally; separate screens support GST filing, purchases, expenses, inventory, reporting, and tax tracking. The store uses a local API and the README describes local-first operation. Some subsystem links are based on the SOURCE INDEX; where server routing is not shown directly, the edge is marked unverified.
